articles.title: Bessent, Lutnick Clash Over Nvidia China Curbs
articles.summary: Axios AI policy reporter Maria Curi tells Bloomberg This Weekend about tensions inside the Trump administration over efforts to restrict the flow of advanced Nvidia chips to China and scrutiny of Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick’s handling of Megaspeed. Speaking with hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini, Curi explains the reported disagreements between Lutnick and other senior officials, including Scott Bessent, and the national security questions surrounding US technology exports to China. (Source: Bloomberg)

articles.title: Trump Heads to China for Talks With Xi and Putin
articles.summary: Bloomberg White House correspondent Jeff Mason tells Bloomberg This Weekend how the Trump administration responded to a nationwide FAA ground stop and Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy’s push for $50 billion to modernize the US air traffic control system. Speaking with hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini, Mason also looks ahead to President Donald Trump’s Asia trip and a planned meeting with Chinese President Xi Jinping as technology and AI remain in focus. (Source: Bloomberg)
